project_type: React SPA with Bun backend (streaming platform)
build_system: Vite for web frontend, Bun for server. Monorepo under apps/
verification_instructions: 1. bun install in apps/web, 2. bun run lint, 3. bun run typecheck, 4. bun run build, 5. bun run test
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Bun 1.2.14 available via mise.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code style: JSX components, Tailwind CSS, React Query for data fetching, lucide-react for icons.
key_patterns: Flat component files in src/components/, page components in src/app/, utilities in src/utils/, i18n in src/i18n/. Path alias @/ maps to src/. Uses React Router v6, Zustand not used (removed), @tanstack/react-query for server state. Server is a single Bun.serve file at apps/server/src/index.js proxying TMDB API.
directory_structure: apps/web/ - React frontend (Vite), apps/server/ - Bun backend (TMDB proxy), apps/mobile/ - React Native/Expo app
